source: Project: Self v2.3 via build spec v1.1, Appendix B

rows.title: Habit
rows.question: Were there 26+ active days including honestly logged MVDs? Does the gym-first evening work?

rows.title: Foundations
rows.question: Can you solve unfamiliar problems from covered patterns? Do DDIA notes match the edition you actually own?

rows.title: Phase 1 exit
rows.question: Which artifacts are complete? What must slip, and by how much?

rows.title: Market and scope
rows.question: Review 20 current postings. Do repeated requirements justify changing the track mix?

rows.title: Canary interviews
rows.question: Send suitable warm-up applications and aim for diagnostic screens if opportunities arise. Record funnel evidence; no count is guaranteed. (Optional learning targets: 8-10 warm-up applications, 2-3 diagnostic screens.)

rows.title: Phase 2 exit
rows.question: Does the modular monolith run? Are tests and eval numbers recorded? Can you defend the architecture for 30 minutes?

rows.title: Readiness
rows.question: Target company list, referral message, resume review and gap list ready?

rows.title: Phase 3 exit
rows.question: Load report, reproducible deployment, case study and recorded mocks complete?

rows.title: Funnel check
rows.question: What do application-to-screen and screen-to-next-stage patterns show?

rows.title: Retrospective
rows.question: What did you ship, what did interviews teach you, and what is the Year 2 plan?
